Not density. Values are standardized relative encounter benchmarks, not deer/km² and not browse damage.

Reporting envelope: modeled U.S. jurisdiction only. Canada is shown for jurisdiction context and is fail-closed as insufficient for this reporting product; no modeled values are exposed there. High-extrapolation cells are neutral gray and expose no modeled value. Habitat and development are held at the governed reference classes (Forest; Rural), so the map isolates modeled geography/year at 30 camera nights rather than claiming cell-specific habitat measurement.
